title: Consensus includes the very book being bet and stale books, so thin soccer prop markets read as value from one outlier
steps: 4 books on one goalscorer: three at +140..+150, one at +200 (fresh)
Another market: one book at +240 but 90 min old
expected: Fair price for line shopping should not be dragged by the book being bet; stale books should not set the consensus.
actual: Fair = de-vigged mean including the outlier (fair 2.67 vs 3.00 best, 12.3% edge). With 4 books the outlier moves the fair price. Stale 90-min book still contributes to consensusP (0.3099 vs 0.3148 without it). Currently ungraded after the coordinator's fixes (consensus-only), so impact is a displayed edge number only. Guess/low priority.
